ProgramUnit.Name: GET_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_units IS
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct unit_id, test_id, coll_date, tb_seq_no, tb_id, 
 testing_lab_code, insert_user_id
 from holding_tests
 where test_chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id 
 and unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and holding_status is null
 and tb_id in ( select tb_id from test_batch_hdr
 where test_chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and substr(tb_id, 8,2) = 'TB'
 and 0= (select count(*) from 
 test_batch_det
 where tb_id = test_batch_hdr.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and (reconcile_flag is not null 
 or test_kit_id is not null))
 and exists (select 'x' from test_batch_det 
 where tb_id = test_batch_hdr.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and test_type = 'M' 
 and (testing_lab_code= :s_testing_lab_code
 or :s_testing_lab_code = '99'))) ; 
 
begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.test_id := c1_rec.test_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.tb_seq_no := c1_rec.tb_seq_no;
 :ctrl_blk_2.tb_id := c1_rec.tb_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.testing_lab_code := c1_rec.testing_lab_code;
 :ctrl_blk_2.insert_user_id := c1_rec.insert_user_id;
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 IF NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id), 0) = 13 THEN 
 :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit := chk_digit_query( :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id, 
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date, 
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 END IF;
 down;
 end loop;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id is null
and :system.trigger_record = '1' 
 
 then
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.unit_id');
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 clear_record;
 --:s_count_units := :system.trigger_record;
 -- :GLOBAL.field_left := 'void_reason_code';
 go_record('1');
end;

Trigger.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 clear_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';
 v_tb_id varchar2(20);
begin
 
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :ctrl_blk_2.s_select_flag = 'X' then 
 begin
 delete from holding_tests
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and tb_id = :ctrl_blk_2.tb_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_2.test_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 clear_flag := 'Y';
 if sql%rowcount = 0 THEN
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in deleting from holding tests.');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 go_record('1');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_success
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 IF clear_flag = 'Y' THEN
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
